explanation: Searched Mathlib for `DiagonalGroup`, `diagonalSubgroup`, `diagonalTorus`, diagonal-subgroup of `GL` and related ext lemmas; Mathlib has no notion of a diagonal subgroup of the general linear group and no ext lemma of this shape. The only Mathlib ingredients the proof uses are the generic `Subtype.ext` and `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.ext` (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/Defs.lean:155), plus `Matrix.diagonal*` facts (`diagonal_apply`, `diagonal_injective`), but those alone do not state the result: the theorem's content is that two elements of this library's own `diagonalSubgroup` are determined by their diagonal entries, which requires case-splitting on `i = j` and using the vanishing off-diagonal hypotheses (`g.2 i j hij`), i.e. an argument of substance about the library's own definition, not a one-step instantiation of any Mathlib declaration.
